name: Principle Of God
overview: The Principle of God reveals His profound love demonstrated through the gift of His only Son, offering eternal life to all who believe. It emphasizes the unity between Christ and the Father, affirming divine oneness, and the transformative power of truth to bring freedom. Believers are called to live worthy of their divine calling, assured that God orchestrates all things for good according to His purpose, even quickening those once dead in sin.
